candidates.test: volatile module load, RAW TX disabled, then svc wifi enable
candidates.result: module loaded, device rebooted before normal Wi-Fi association could be verified
candidates.failure_cause: unproven; pstore empty and no SYSTEM_LAST_KMSG entry after reboot
candidates.action: quarantined; no repeated experimental load without a diagnosis and a revised candidate
candidates.subsequent_static_finding: WLAN_CTRL_NAME=wlan omitted: no state-control callback/device in candidate, despite stock /dev/wlan and Android.mk integration. Revised build includes it; causal relationship to reboot not yet proven.

candidates.test: WLAN_CTRL_NAME=wlan built; state control confirmed; RAW TX disabled; then Wi-Fi enable
candidates.result: device rebooted during firmware initialization; normal association unverified
candidates.stock_restored_after_boot: g939d76a86982; con_mode=0; Wi-Fi connected; resident services running
candidates.failure_cause: not identified; last captured pre-reboot kernel stage was CNSS ini sync request
candidates.action: quarantined; no repeat load; compare platform integration and improve unbuffered capture

candidates.test: State control and runtime PM enabled; PCIe tables match stock; RAW TX disabled; Wi-Fi enable
candidates.result: device rebooted before association; raw native kmsg stream ends at CNSS ini sync request
candidates.failure_cause: unproven; backend logging does not preserve this panic
candidates.action: quarantined; no repeat experimental driver load until exception diagnostics yield a cause

diagnostic_reproduction.observed: panic entry from HIF PCIe initialization; corrupted unwind value 0x3d0000495254535f
diagnostic_reproduction.confirmed_boundary_issue: stock cnss_get_soc_info copies 129 bytes to output+0x98; candidate output buffer is 152 bytes and stack canary follows it
diagnostic_reproduction.followup: 0005 restores the missing field in CNSS and PLD headers with compile-time offset and size checks

candidates.test: Associated STA + same-channel monitor experiment requested; ordinary Wi-Fi startup prerequisite
candidates.result: PE session-array allocation failed before ordinary association or monitor creation; device did not reboot
candidates.failure_cause: Captured page allocation failure order:5 at pe_open+0xb8 (__qdf_mem_malloc); no order-5 or larger free pages, despite ~323MiB total free. Does not prove a monitor-concurrency failure.
candidates.recovery: guardian eventually restored stock after ~85 seconds, including CNSS 80000ms power-up wait. Test shell initially reported restore_pending. Afterwards wifi HAL + wificond restarted and normal stock association/ping confirmed.
candidates.action: quarantined; next candidate uses qdf_mem_valloc/vfree for CPU-only PE table, including both frees; no repeated unchanged load

candidates.test: 0022 RAW firmware resource RX format plus standard per-STA Ethernet overrides; mission mode
candidates.result: Associated, but ordinary gateway prerequisite failed; iw RX/TX stayed zero; monitor/capture not started
candidates.action: Do not repeat an ordinary run with RAW resource flag enabled. Subsequent descriptor-observation candidate keeps that flag disabled.

candidates.test: 0028 deferred monitor WMA detach; strict AWDL TLV observation
candidates.result: 17 AWDL received, 14 strict complete TLV chains; monitor delete timed out, recovery followed by dp_mon_vdev_timer null-pointer panic and reboot
candidates.action: quarantined; do not load unchanged candidate; original modules restored automatically on boot
candidates.failure_cause: STOP completion did not reach deferred cleanup before HDD delete timeout. Deferring DP detach also left a polling timer live during recovery; exact missing callback boundary remains unproven.

candidates.result: 17? AWDL receive succeeded, but monitor deletion timed out and dp_mon_vdev_timer still faulted; reboot
candidates.failure_cause: Stopping at datapath detach was later than logical deletion; timer callback retained stale context

candidates.result: AWDL receive succeeded; monitor deletion timed out; dp_mon_vdev_timer still faulted/rebooted
candidates.failure_cause: Rearm guard alone could not protect cleanup ordering

candidates.result: AWDL receive succeeded (6 frames); monitor deletion timed out; CNSS recovery hit target_if_deinit_dbr_ring+0x1f4 and rebooted
candidates.failure_cause: Direct-buffer-ring teardown ownership/order remains invalid after asynchronous monitor delete; not a timer-only issue
candidates.action: quarantined; no repeat load until static direct-buffer teardown audit
